address.docs:
**int**: Manually specify the I²C address of the temperature & pressure sensor. Defaults to `0x76`.

*See also: [MS8607 Temperature+Pressure+Humidity Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ms8607#configuration-variables)*

**int**: Manually specify the I²C address of the humidity sensor. Defaults to `0x40`.

*See also: [MS8607 Temperature+Pressure+Humidity Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ms8607#configuration-variables)*

i2c_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID of the [I²C Component](https://esphome.io/components/i2c) if your configuration uses multiple I²C buses. This should match the `i2c_id` documented below.

*See also: [MS8607 Temperature+Pressure+Humidity Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ms8607#configuration-variables)*

humidity.docs:
The information for the humidity sensor.

*See also: [MS8607 Temperature+Pressure+Humidity Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ms8607#configuration-variables)*

i2c_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID of the [I²C Component](https://esphome.io/components/i2c) if your configuration uses multiple I²C buses. This should match the `i2c_id` inside of `humidity`, documented above.

*See also: [MS8607 Temperature+Pressure+Humidity Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ms8607#configuration-variables)*

pressure.docs:
The information for the pressure sensor. All options from [Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor).

*See also: [MS8607 Temperature+Pressure+Humidity Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ms8607#configuration-variables)*

temperature.docs:
The information for the temperature sensor. All options from [Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor).

*See also: [MS8607 Temperature+Pressure+Humidity Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ms8607#configuration-variables)*

update_interval.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: The interval to check the sensor. Defaults to `60s`.

*See also: [MS8607 Temperature+Pressure+Humidity Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ms8607#configuration-variables)*
